summary: One event in a Timeline: what happened, who did it, when — then the detail. An `<li>` with a decorative marker.

requires: a Timeline parent — an `<li>` outside a list is invalid
a `title` in words: the icon is hidden, so it cannot be the only sign of what kind of event it was
guarantees: the time is a `<time>` whose `dateTime` is the exact instant
`timestampLabel` changes only the words shown, never the instant
the separator between actor and time, the marker and the icon are hidden from assistive tech

antiPatterns.dont: title="purpose" with the change as the detail
antiPatterns.do: title="Changed the purpose", and the old and new text as the detail
antiPatterns.why: the title is what a screen reader hears first and what a person scans; a field name alone does not say what happened
